title: Short-Notice Start Loading on Professional Services Projects Deposits
content:
For Professional Services Projects time-and-materials statements of work, a scheduled start close to the signature date raises the deposit percentage.

When the scheduled start date is 14 or fewer calendar days after the signature date, including a scheduled start date on or before the signature date, 5.0 percentage points are added to the deposit percentage, 2.5 points when it is more than 14 but no more than 30 calendar days after it, and none when it is later.

| Scheduled start date, in calendar days after the signature date | Points added |
|---|---|
| on or before the signature date | 5.0 |
| 1 to 14 | 5.0 |
| 15 to 30 | 2.5 |
| 31 or more | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Scheduled start 14 calendar days after signature: 5.0 points; 15 days after: 2.5 points.
- Scheduled start 30 calendar days after signature: 2.5 points; 31 days after: none.
- Scheduled start three days before the signature date: 5.0 points.
